glossEn: one of the groups of Christians who have their own beliefs and forms of worship
note: one of the groups of Christians who have their own beliefs and their own form of worship。指**组织/派别**。线索：the Catholic / Anglican Church。现有中文无对应，属新增。注意与 s3 分界：s3 是「某一地的堂会」，本条是「跨地区的教派」。

glossEn: a place for public (especially Christian) worship
note: a place for public (especially Christian) worship。指**建筑物**。**本词最常用的义，但现有中文只有形容词形式**，故属新增。线索：go to church / the church organ。

glossZh: 教众，堂会（某地的一群信徒）
glossEn: the body of people who attend or belong to a particular local church
note: the body of people who attend or belong to a particular local congregation。线索：the local church / a small church。规模比教派小。

glossEn: perform a special church rite or service for
note: perform a special church rite or service for。罕见但真实。线索：church someone.
